title: Implement MQ request/reply and cross-resource authorization transactions
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of mq_authorization_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: Three pinned MQ programs compile to legal artifacts and expose all five reached verbs: seven MQOPEN, three MQGET, four MQPUT, one MQPUT1, and seven MQCLOSE calls. Interpreter lowering routes the COBOL MQ ABI through typed queue requests and writes handles, result codes, lengths, message IDs, and correlation IDs back to exact storage.

CD.J15 executes date and account request/reply routes with exact payload bytes, 24-byte correlation selection, trigger selection, syncpoint get/put, MQRC 2033 no-message behavior, and durable queue restart state.

CD.J16 executes approval and decline replies, duplicate IMS insert replay, root/child mutation, and staged MQ output. Actual CICS SYNCPOINT coordinates Db2, IMS, and MQ commit; SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK removes both staged IMS and MQ state.

CD.J17 navigates IMS summary/detail records with qualified GU and parent-scoped GNP, then executes the pinned 26-column CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS shape with insert, rollback, commit, fraud update, and exact persisted fraud marker.

CD.J18 submits the untouched pinned CBPAUP0J job through the public z/OSMF route. For the pinned expiry-days zero control, the BMP controller walks and deletes every root and child without cursor skips, checkpoints, and leaves an exact empty hierarchy; the associated keyed account adjustment is verified separately byte-for-byte. Zowe CLI 8.36.0 independently observes JOB00001 at OUTPUT CC 0000 and the initialized live fixture at EXPIRY-DAYS=00, ROOTS=1, CHILDREN=1, CHECKPOINT=CD02600001, and SUMMARY-AUTHORIZATION-ADJUSTED=1.

Seven queues and three triggers install atomically with idempotent replay. Correlation, authorization denial, rollback, unknown-outcome exact-once replay, CICS syncpoint intent/result, provider limits, and memory-store warm restart controls fail closed or preserve exact durable state as required.
